name: Darkling beetle (Physadesmia globosa)
description: The darkling beetle Physadesmia globosa of the dune base near the Kuiseb riverbed - its carbon isotope signature matches the Nara melon rather than the fog grass, while its nitrogen isotopes (like the other darkling beetle's) suggest an omnivore above its plant-based carbon. Species node matching the source's Physadesmia globosa taxon.
